quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not reviewer findings or actual quiz draws. Direct symmetric/nontransitive guards assess actual labels and ordinary full senses, including qualified labels. Shared topics, related objects and older indirect protections do not establish new pairs.
センチ's additional sentimental teaching is distinct from measurement. しんみり overlaps in sentimental mood; different measurement units are not automatically synonymous.
宣伝 directly protects 広告 without inventing a universal paid/unpaid advertising boundary.

先頭 assesses actual front/head/top/first/leading labels including 頭's non-anatomical senses and 正面's front label. These precautions do not make every physical head, facade, tip or first event a queue leader.
全般 considers actual whole/all/general labels and noun-suffix use. 一般's general sense overlaps, but ordinary/normal 普通 is not automatically entire scope. みんな also includes things, not people alone.
線路 directly assesses broader 線 and 鉄道. Different vehicles and drawn paths are not synonyms merely because transport or lines are involved.
相違 considers actual difference/distinction/differ labels. Identical complete title 違い deduplicates already. Temporal 変化 is not automatically static discrepancy.
そういえば considers ところで's adjacent conversational label without making them interchangeable in every discourse. Addition, consequence and memory verbs are not automatic equivalents.
雑巾 safeguards broader cloth 布; towels and handkerchiefs retain different ordinary object identities even if usable for wiping.

増減 considers actual quantity-change, increase/decrease, adjustment and rise labels, including 加減 and 上がる. Each pair is direct; no change/increase clique is inferred. The 増大 pair is declared here, not redundantly at both ends.
相互 directly protects 互い/お互い. Joint 共同 and together 一緒 do not automatically denote reciprocity.

創作 considers creative production, making, creative result, fiction and fabrication/invention senses. Broader manufacture labels warrant conservative precautions without declaring all mass production original art or every fiction a lie. Prior 制作 guards do not protect new 創作.

葬式 considers broader ceremony and religious-service labels. 勤め actually has a Buddhist-service sense. サービス's broad English service title warrants only a conservative label precaution: its complete Japanese senses do not establish a religious-service sense.
造船 considers broader manufacture/production/industry and making labels; ships and travel are not shipbuilding. Do not add every construction word solely for sharing an industry topic.
騒々しい directly considers ordinary noise/commotion/lively senses, including 賑やか's noisy overlap. Weather ぐずぐず is not treated as the same situation merely from English unsettled.

増大 considers actual increase/enlargement/expansion/growth/rise senses. 成長 is not uniformly biological maturation and 上がる has an ordinary increase sense. All new edges are assessed independently of older ones.
送別 considers actual seeing-off/parting/farewell labels. 見送り also has postponement; the other parting topic does not equate every breakup verb.

草履 considers broader sandals/footwear labels. 下駄's related traditional footwear identity remains a contrast, not a synonym by topic. 倉庫 and 扇風機 have no new guards: related storage and cooling devices are not automatically equivalent names.

freshAuthorPublicInspection.heading: そうぞう‐し・い【忩忩・騒騒サウザウ】
freshAuthorPublicInspection.observation: The current form is an i-adjective with an older literary inflection. The entry questions whether 騒騒 is ateji and discusses competing derivations, including formation from 忩忩, other repeated bases and a proposed sound change from さわさわ. It does not establish a settled native origin merely from the i-adjective ending.
freshAuthorPublicInspection.repositoryConvention: docs/content-format.md:63 offers no mixed type and groups on-first mixed words as kango. Applying that study category to the modern on-based form plus Japanese adjective ending must not be presented as proof of the disputed historical derivation.

adjudications.decision: Add 増大/激増 for ordinary increase against sharp increase, 1403310:1 and 1253690:1. The speed qualifier is preserved; old guards through 増加 do not propagate.

Add 全般/丸 for whole-scope versus ordinary entirety/whole/full sense 1216250:2, alongside 1396020:1-2. Current まる whole-amount use is taught in the actual article, not inferred from circle shape or separate がん 2252570.

Add 草履/下駄 because actual traditional Japanese sandals wording can answer the existing geta item. 1402060:1 and 1185780:1 retain distinct footwear shapes; broad English label overlap does not merge identities or materials.

Add 騒々しい/ざわざわ for ordinary noisy commotion, 1596440:1 and 1005430:1, confirmed in the complete old body. This does not transfer rustling-leaf or chill senses wholesale, or depend only on unsettled English wording.
Add 創作/架空 for fabrication/made-up material, 1398420:2 and 1193130:1. The latter sense is restricted to かくう, not がくう; its overhead sense does not erase ordinary imaginary/fabricated content.

Add 先頭/表 using actual head/front/lead and front/outward-facing-side titles, 1596210:1 and 1489340:3. Queue head and object front remain different uses; the old 正面/表 edge is not proof and does not propagate. Separate chart 1489350 is not this front sense.

Change type/tag from wago to kango as this collection's on-first mixed study category, not a proven historical derivation. Remove the unsupported definite native-origin claim and distinguish on-based そうぞう plus Japanese adjective ending from native さわ in 騒がしい. Actual KANJIDIC2 records ソウ/さわ.がしい; fresh 精選版日本国語大辞典 discusses competing origins and possible ateji, so the literal proposed etymology is not imposed as settled.
